t: You're at Stamford Bridge, home of Chelsea Football Club, in Fulham, West London. The club was founded in 1905 and took its name from the neighbouring area of Chelsea. Two businessmen matter here: Gus Mears and Joseph Mears, who founded the club between them. Today Chelsea play in the Premier League, and they rank among the most successful clubs in English football, with six top flight league titles, eight FA Cups, and two Champions League wins among their honours.
